subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should iOS permanently replace the tab bar and Control hub with the sidebar shell while retaining the expanded native Overview dashboard rather than following the web Overview-retirement direction?
rationale: The branch is a protected maintainer-labeled root-navigation redesign, and the cited web direction favors sidebar-owned surfaces while this iOS implementation keeps and expands Overview.

options.title: Approve the iOS-specific sidebar and Overview direction
options.body: Keep the sidebar shell and native Overview dashboard, provided the three current-head session and approval defects are repaired before merge.

options.title: Converge more closely with web
options.body: Narrow the iOS redesign so sidebar attention and destination pages replace the expanded Overview dashboard before landing.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Defer the root-navigation replacement until the iOS product direction is documented and explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the iOS-specific sidebar and Overview direction
recommendation.body: Keep the sidebar shell and native Overview dashboard, provided the three current-head session and approval defects are repaired before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties steipete to both the branch and the related navigation-direction discussion.
